cascade-window-width.description: Width of every cascaded window; 0 for half the work area's

cascade-window-height.description: Height of every cascaded window; 0 for half the work area's

cascade-offset-across.description: Offset from one window to the next, rightward from a left corner and leftward from a right one

cascade-offset-up.description: Offset from one window to the next, upward from a bottom corner and downward from a top one

cascade-margin-across.description: The anchor's distance from the corner's side edge; negative pulls it past the edge and trims the windows that would leave the screen

cascade-margin-up.description: The anchor's distance from the corner's top or bottom edge; negative pulls it past the edge and trims the windows that would leave the screen

cascade-spread.description: Spread the windows across the whole work area, never wrapping

columns-count.description: Number of columns the windows are dealt into

columns-area.description: The area the columns fill, as grid cells, managed from the chooser; empty for the whole work area

grid-layouts.description: Grid layouts: spans typed as numbers with spaces between, 1 2 1 for a wide middle column

grid-last-layout.description: The layout the grid last showed, managed from the chooser

participants.description: Desktop ids of the applications ticked by default, comma-separated; empty ticks the focused window's application

presets.description: Saved presets, managed from the chooser
